d: Something strange is accelerating through our solar system, and conventional physics cannot explain why. Harvard astrophysicist Avi Loeb has sparked a massive debate by suggesting asteroid 1998 KY26 could actually be Phobos 1, a Soviet probe lost in 1988. Now, NASA chief Jared Isaacman has stepped in to weigh the evidence. We break down the bizarre science behind this speeding object and what NASA really thinks is out there.
